column1: # Danish for Prusa's CONNECT error catalogue - the one language Prusa do not ship.
# Hand-written and hand-maintained: tools/error-codes/generate.py reads this file and merges it
# with the translations lifted from firmware's own .po catalogues, so regenerating never overwrites
# it. A code with no row here falls back to English, the same as any language Prusa has not
# Terminology follows the app's own Danish rather than a literal rendering: dyse, byggeplade,
# filament, varmelegeme. Firmware's line breaks are dropped by the generator - these are one-line
# sentences on a web card, not text for a 4-inch LCD.
